content.title: Wrist-Device Action State | Rain Baseline, Energy Route and Standing Return
content.summary: An adult courier activates a wrist relay, clears one cable and returns to the canopy. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing all source-specific surfaces.

quick_start.input_format: The lead is explicitly adult and retains face, hair and clothing. + The device activates before performance mode begins. + One continuous route links run and return. + Exactly one bounded energy action occurs. + The final standing state reconnects to the opening environment.
quick_start.recommended_input: One clearly adult original courier with copper hair stands beneath a blue rain canopy. Only after activation, she sprints along the same lane past two registered signs. She lands on one knee, looks back once and stands beneath the same blue canopy.
required_anchors: The lead is explicitly adult and retains face, hair and clothing.
The device activates before performance mode begins.
Exactly one bounded energy action occurs.
The final standing state reconnects to the opening environment.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.

creative_dna.mechanism: 同一明确成年动漫角色在霓虹雨巷先保持观察，腕部装置启动后才进入奔跑与光刃动作；地理、脸和衣装连续，最后在同一路线重新站稳。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: The lead is explicitly adult and retains face, hair and clothing.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "The lead is explicitly adult and retains face, hair and clothing."

invariants.rule: The device activates before performance mode begins.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "The device activates before performance mode begins."

invariants.rule: One continuous route links run and return.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "One continuous route links run and return."

invariants.rule: Exactly one bounded energy action occurs.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Exactly one bounded energy action occurs."

invariants.rule: The final standing state reconnects to the opening environment.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final standing state reconnects to the opening environment."
